ports.name: clk_i
ports.functionality: Supplies the rising-edge clock for all clocked processes. Sequences pointer registers, memory write/read flops and status-register updates used by the FIFO logic.
ports.evidence: rising_edge(clk_i) in pointer_reg, write_* processes, async_r_pnt_reg, sync_read_large and sync_status processes

ports.name: rstn_i
ports.functionality: Provides asynchronous reset that clears pointer registers, memory/register storage and synchronized status outputs in reset branches. Overrides normal updates when '0'.
ports.evidence: if (rstn_i = '0') branches in pointer_reg, write_reset_* and sync_status processes

ports.name: clear_i
ports.functionality: When asserted forces the combinational next pointers w_nxt and r_nxt to zero, overriding increment logic and thereby clearing pointer progression.
ports.evidence: w_nxt <= (others => '0') when (clear_i = '1') else ... and r_nxt <= (others => '0') when (clear_i = '1') else ...

ports.name: half_o
ports.functionality: Exports the FIFO half/full indicator to the outside. In the asynchronous-status configuration it is driven combinationally from internal 'half'; in the synchronous-status configuration it is captured into half_o on clk_i.
ports.evidence: half_o <= half in async branch; sync_status process assigns half_o <= '0' in reset and half_o <= half on rising_edge(clk_i)

ports.name: level_o
ports.functionality: Reports the FIFO fill level by extending internal 'level' into the 32-bit output. A combinational process writes low bits from 'level' into level_o and zeros the remaining bits.
ports.evidence: level_extend process: level_o(level'left downto 0) <= level(level'left downto 0)

ports.name: wdata_i
ports.functionality: Supplies the FIFO write word. Is captured into fifo_reg or written into fifo_mem at the addressed write location when internal 'we' enables a write.
ports.evidence: fifo_reg <= wdata_i and fifo_mem(...) <= wdata_i inside write_* processes

ports.name: we_i
ports.functionality: Provides the raw write request input; combined with internal 'free' when FIFO_SAFE is true to form internal 'we' which gates writes and pointer increments.
ports.evidence: we <= we_i when (FIFO_SAFE = false) else (we_i and free)

ports.name: free_o
ports.functionality: Exports the FIFO free (not-full) status. In asynchronous-status mode it is driven directly from internal 'free'; in synchronous mode it is registered into free_o on clk_i.
ports.evidence: free_o <= free in async branch; sync_status process assigns free_o <= free on rising_edge(clk_i)

ports.name: re_i
ports.functionality: Provides the raw read request; combined with internal 'avail' when FIFO_SAFE is true to form internal 're' which gates read-pointer advancement.
ports.evidence: re <= re_i when (FIFO_SAFE = false) else (re_i and avail)

ports.name: rdata_o
ports.functionality: Exports the FIFO output word. Driven either directly from fifo_reg (depth=1) or from fifo_mem indexed by r_pnt_ff (async read) or r_pnt (sync read), combinationally or registered depending on FIFO_RSYNC.
ports.evidence: rdata_o <= fifo_reg (small) and rdata_o <= fifo_mem(to_integer(unsigned(r_pnt_ff(...)))) or assigned in sync_read_large process from fifo_mem

ports.name: avail_o
ports.functionality: Exports the FIFO available (not-empty) status. In async mode driven combinationally from internal 'avail'; in sync mode captured into avail_o on clk_i.
ports.evidence: avail_o <= avail in async branch; sync_status process assigns avail_o <= avail on rising_edge(clk_i)

signals.name: fifo_mem
signals.functionality: Holds FIFO entries across cycles. Is written from wdata_i at address derived from w_pnt on writes, read by rdata_o via r_pnt_ff or r_pnt, and reset to zeros when FULL_RESET path is active.
signals.evidence: fifo_mem(...) <= wdata_i in write_* processes; rdata_o <= fifo_mem(to_integer(unsigned(r_pnt_ff(...)))) and reset fifo_mem <= (others => (others => '0')) in write_reset_large

signals.name: fifo_reg
signals.functionality: Used when FIFO depth equals 1; captures wdata_i on writes and directly supplies rdata_o on reads; reset to zero in FULL_RESET mode.
signals.evidence: fifo_reg <= wdata_i inside write_small / write_reset_small; rdata_o <= fifo_reg in read small branches

signals.name: we
signals.functionality: Derived internal write enable used by write logic. Equals we_i or we_i AND free depending on FIFO_SAFE; gates writes to storage and increments the write pointer.
signals.evidence: we <= we_i when (FIFO_SAFE = false) else (we_i and free); used as condition if (we = '1') then fifo_mem(...) <= wdata_i and w_nxt updates when (we = '1')

signals.name: re
signals.functionality: Derived internal read enable that is the input re_i possibly masked by avail when FIFO_SAFE is true. Gates read-pointer advancement (r_nxt) and thus reads.
signals.evidence: re <= re_i when (FIFO_SAFE = false) else (re_i and avail); r_nxt <= ... when (re = '1') else ...

signals.name: match
signals.functionality: Indicates whether the lower index bits of r_pnt and w_pnt are equal; used together with MSB bits to determine full/empty conditions.
signals.evidence: match <= '1' when (r_pnt(...)=w_pnt(...)) else '0' in generate check_large/small

signals.name: empty
signals.functionality: Indicates FIFO empty condition computed from pointer bits and match; used to form avail and to gate reads in safe mode.
signals.evidence: empty <= '1' when (r_pnt(...)=w_pnt(...)) and (match='1') else '0'; avail <= not empty

signals.name: full
signals.functionality: Indicates FIFO full condition computed from pointer MSB bits and match; used to form free and to prevent writes in safe mode.
signals.evidence: full <= '1' when (r_pnt(r_pnt'left) /= w_pnt(w_pnt'left)) and (match = '1') else '0'; free <= not full

signals.name: half
signals.functionality: Derived from the top bit(s) of 'level' or from 'full' in small depth case; drives the external half_o status signal.
signals.evidence: half <= level(level'left-1) or full in large case; half <= full in small case; half_o <= half in async branch

signals.name: free
signals.functionality: Logical negation of 'full'. Feeds the safe-mode write gating and the free_o export.
signals.evidence: free <= not full; used in we <= we_i when ... else (we_i and free); free_o <= free in async branch

signals.name: avail
signals.functionality: Logical negation of 'empty'. Feeds safe-mode read gating and the avail_o export.
signals.evidence: avail <= not empty; used in re <= re_i when ... else (re_i and avail); avail_o <= avail in async branch

signals.name: w_pnt
signals.functionality: Holds the current write pointer across cycles; captures w_nxt on clock and its lower bits index fifo_mem for writes; participates in full/empty/level calculations.
signals.evidence: pointer_reg process assigns w_pnt <= w_nxt; fifo_mem(...) uses w_pnt(w_pnt'left-1 downto 0); match/full/level compute use w_pnt

signals.name: w_nxt
signals.functionality: Combinational next-state for the write pointer: cleared when clear_i='1', incremented when 'we'='1', otherwise holds w_pnt. Feeds w_pnt register on the clock edge.
signals.evidence: w_nxt <= (others=>'0') when (clear_i='1') else std_ulogic_vector(unsigned(w_pnt)+1) when (we='1') else w_pnt; w_pnt <= w_nxt in pointer_reg

signals.name: r_pnt
signals.functionality: Holds the current read pointer across cycles; captures r_nxt on clock and its lower bits index fifo_mem for synchronous reads; used in status and level calculations.
signals.evidence: pointer_reg assigns r_pnt <= r_nxt; check_large uses r_pnt slices; sync_read_large reads fifo_mem using r_pnt

signals.name: r_nxt
signals.functionality: Combinational next-state for the read pointer: cleared when clear_i='1', incremented when 're'='1', otherwise holds r_pnt. Feeds r_pnt register on clock edge or r_pnt_ff in async path.
signals.evidence: r_nxt <= (others=>'0') when (clear_i='1') else ... when (re='1') else r_pnt; r_pnt <= r_nxt in pointer_reg; r_pnt_ff <= r_nxt in async_r_pnt_reg

signals.name: r_pnt_ff
signals.functionality: Clocked flop that captures r_nxt for use by asynchronous read logic; its lower bits index fifo_mem for async rdata_o sourcing.

signals.name: level
signals.functionality: Represents FIFO fill level as std_ulogic_vector computed from unsigned(w_pnt) - unsigned(r_pnt) (or all-full value for depth=1). Drives 'half' and is exported to level_o.
signals.evidence: level <= std_ulogic_vector(unsigned(w_pnt) - unsigned(r_pnt)) in check_large; level_o(level'left downto 0) <= level(level'left downto 0) in level_extend
